description: Golden signals (traffic, latency, errors, saturation) of the ScaleBotAI FastAPI service.

panels.description: Number of API replicas Prometheus can scrape (dns_sd in compose, pod discovery in k8s).
panels.title: Replicas up

panels.description: Total HTTP requests per second handled by the selected replicas (/metrics and /health* excluded).
panels.title: Requests / sec

panels.description: Mean response time over 5 minutes. Success criterion: < 300 ms.
panels.title: Avg latency (SLO < 300 ms)

panels.description: 95th percentile response time over 5 minutes.
panels.title: P95 latency

panels.description: Share of requests answered with 5xx over 5 minutes. Success criterion: < 1%.
panels.title: Error rate (5xx)

panels.description: Application-level Redis cache hit ratio (bot_response + user + analytics caches).
panels.title: Cache hit ratio

panels.description: Time since the most recently (re)started replica booted. Drops to ~0 on deploys, restarts and scale-ups.
panels.title: Uptime (youngest replica)

panels.description: scalebot_app_info: running version, chatbot mode (rule | llm) and environment.
panels.title: App info

panels.description: Requests currently being processed (Little's Law: in-flight = RPS x latency).
panels.title: In-flight requests

panels.description: Requests rejected by the application rate limiter (RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE).
panels.title: Rate-limited / sec

panels.description: checked_out / DB_POOL_SIZE on the busiest replica. >100% means overflow connections (DB_MAX_OVERFLOW) are used.
panels.title: DB pool usage (max replica)

panels.description: Throughput of the API. 2xx should dominate; 429 = rate limited, 5xx = server errors.
panels.title: Requests / sec - total and by status

panels.description: Traffic per templated route (e.g. /api/v1/chat/conversations/{conversation_id}).
panels.title: Requests / sec by route

panels.description: Latency percentiles from scalebot_http_request_duration_seconds. Dashed red line = 300 ms SLO.
panels.title: Response time - P50 / P95 / P99 / average

panels.description: Which endpoint is slow? Login is expected to be slower (bcrypt).
panels.title: P95 latency by route

panels.description: Error ratios. The 1% line is the success criterion for 5xx; 4xx (401/404/422/429) are client-side.
panels.title: Error rate %

panels.description: Where errors come from. Correlate with Kibana index scalebot-error-logs-*.
panels.title: Non-2xx responses by route and status

panels.description: rate(process_cpu_seconds_total): CPU cores used by each uvicorn process. Limit = 1 core; alert at 0.8.
panels.title: CPU usage (cores)

panels.description: Resident memory per replica. Orange = 400Mi alert threshold (~80%), red = 512Mi container limit.
panels.title: Memory (RSS)

panels.description: Concurrent in-flight requests per replica.
panels.title: Requests in progress

panels.description: SQLAlchemy async pool. checked_out approaching size => requests start waiting (DB_POOL_TIMEOUT).
panels.title: DB pool - checked out vs size

panels.description: Garbage-collector activity. A steady rise together with RSS growth hints at a memory leak.
panels.title: Python GC collections / sec

panels.description: Chat throughput per engine (rule | llm | rule-fallback). rule-fallback > 0 means the LLM timed out.
panels.title: Chat messages / sec by bot_mode

panels.description: Time spent generating the answer (excludes HTTP/DB overhead).
panels.title: Bot engine response time (P95) by mode

panels.description: Hit ratio per cache (bot_response | user | analytics). Alert below 50%.
panels.title: Cache hit ratio by cache

panels.description: register | login_success | login_failure | logout | refresh. A login_failure spike may be credential stuffing.
panels.title: Auth events / sec

panels.description: Requests rejected by the app limiter. NGINX limit_req rejections never reach the app - see the NGINX panels.
panels.title: Rate-limited requests / sec

title: ScaleBotAI - API Overview
